text:
Hello:)

My wife's family will come soon for a 10 day visit in Israel (two parents and a brother). 

My wife has an A5 visa. Her family all come with french passports, and they have their ETA approved.

Our PIBA clerk said that in this case an invitation letter from me should be enough, no need to apply for a visa in advance.

Any advice on what to write \ not to write in the letter?

Any template I should use?

Any advice on what they should say in the passport control?

Thanks ❤️
